policy: A flag is a fact about the retrieved evidence, not a guess. Every flag below names the page that was read. Nothing here is published as a product fact on the item tables; items with a missing value keep that value blank.

flags.title: 16 of 19 listings never use the words "solid gold"
flags.detail: UPDATED 2026-10-22 (session S-75094819). The buying checklist requires the listing itself to say 'solid gold', not plated / vermeil / gold-filled / overlay / gold-tone. 16 of the 19 captured listings state a karat (10K/14K/18K) but never use the phrase 'solid gold'. The 3 exceptions are the Stone and Strand rings added in this pass (SS-CLARA, SS-RITA, SS-MIA): each product page carries a 'Solid Gold' badge and the sentence 'set in 14K solid gold or platinum'. Absence was checked in the retrieved page text for each item. Absence of the phrase is a documentation gap, not proof that a ring is plated — and presence of the phrase is not proof of purity either: all three Stone and Strand rings are final sale (F-016), so they cannot be returned after an XRF test.
flags.recommended_action: Ask each seller in writing to confirm 'solid gold, not plated or filled' and keep the reply with the order record.

flags.title: No listing states a hallmark or maker's mark
flags.detail: The checklist asks for a 10K/14K/18K stamp PLUS a maker's/manufacturer's mark. None of the 19 product pages states what is stamped inside the band, and none names a manufacturer's mark. Blue Nile and VRAI do publish stock/style numbers, which is not the same thing as a physical hallmark. The 3 Stone and Strand pages added 2026-10-22 are no different: no stamp, no maker's mark, and not even a SKU in the retrieved text.
flags.recommended_action: On arrival, photograph the inside of the band and have an independent jeweller read the stamp and maker's mark under magnification.

flags.title: Metal weight in grams is not published for 18 of 19 items
flags.detail: Only VRAI publishes a metal weight (2.86 g at size 6 for the Classic 4-prong). For the other 18 listings — including the 3 Stone and Strand rings added 2026-10-22 — the gram weight field is left blank rather than estimated. Stone and Strand publishes carat weights and band widths but no metal weight in grams. Without a weight, a price-per-gram or melt comparison cannot be computed for those items.
flags.recommended_action: Request the gram weight from the seller before paying, then verify on a jeweller's scale after delivery.

flags.title: Zales V-19957449: cached snippet $719.20 vs live page $899.00
flags.detail: A search-engine snippet for this product showed 'Discounted Price $719.20, Original Price $899.00, 20% Off'. The live product page retrieved on 2026-10-22 shows 'Discounted Price $899.00' with no original price and no discount. The live value is recorded; the snippet value is rejected and kept only as an audit note.
flags.recommended_action: Re-check the price in the cart at checkout; do not budget from any cached figure.

flags.title: Blue Nile 193625: snippet $1,845 vs live page $1,950
flags.detail: A search-engine snippet for the Petite Three-Stone in 14k yellow gold showed $1,845. The live page on 2026-10-22 showed $1,950 (Setting Price). Live value recorded.
flags.recommended_action: Treat all Blue Nile prices as live-only; re-check before ordering.

flags.title: Blue Nile 315661: snippet showed -25% ($1,657) but live page shows $2,210
flags.detail: The cached snippet advertised a 25% reduction to $1,657. The live page showed $2,210 (Setting Price) with no discount banner in the retrieved text. The higher, live figure is recorded. A promotional price may still exist in-cart; it was not verifiable at retrieval.
flags.recommended_action: If a promo is claimed, capture the cart screen with the discount line before paying.

flags.title: Brilliant Earth price was served in EUR, not USD
flags.detail: The Brilliant Earth page rendered '€ 990.00 (Setting Only)' at retrieval, and the site's currency selector showed EUR active. The USD price was never displayed, so it is not recorded and no exchange-rate conversion was invented. The item is marked with currency EUR.
flags.recommended_action: Switch the site region to United States to read the USD price before comparing with the other rows.

flags.title: VRAI price is rendered client-side and was absent from the retrieved HTML
flags.detail: The VRAI configurator page supplied full specs (18k yellow gold, 2.86 g metal weight, 1.6 mm band depth, 30-day returns) but no price string was present in the retrieved text. The price field is deliberately blank. A search snippet claimed 'Starting at $1,035' - that figure is rejected and shown only as an audit note.
flags.recommended_action: Read the price in the VRAI configurator directly, or request a written quote.

flags.title: James Allen product URLs now redirect to Blue Nile and some items are sold out
flags.detail: jamesallen.com/.../comfort-fit-engagement-ring-item-41515 (listed at $660 in a cached snippet) redirected to bluenile.com and rendered 'This popular style is sold out'. James Allen settings are now sold inside the Blue Nile catalogue, so brand and seller are no longer the same entity. Item 41515 is excluded from the tables.
flags.recommended_action: Buy James Allen designs through the Blue Nile listing and note that the warranty/contact entity is Blue Nile.

flags.title: Blue Nile returns exclude items resized after purchase and custom orders
flags.detail: Blue Nile's official return page states a 30-day window from shipment and explicitly excludes 'items resized after initial purchase', custom orders, engraved items and personalised jewellery. Since the checklist requires inspecting and verifying before resizing, resize AFTER the independent test and only once the ring is confirmed.
flags.recommended_action: Order the ring in your size; do not accept a resize before XRF testing.

flags.title: Zales return policy now captured; resized-ring treatment and contact details still not stated
flags.detail: RESOLVED IN PART on 2026-10-22 (session S-75094819): Zales' standalone return policy was retrieved from zales.com. It states returns within 30 days of the purchase (shipped) date, jewelry exchanges within 60 days, excludes custom designs, and offers a prepaid mail return label. Still unverified: the retrieved policy text does not address resized or sized-to-order rings, and no contact phone/email was captured on the retrieved pages, so those fields stay blank. The canonical policy page body was not extractable by the text fetcher, so the text was read from Zales' official modal rendition of the same policy; both URLs are linked below. A lookalike domain (zales-jewelry.com) appeared in search results and was rejected as a source — it is not Zales' official site.
flags.recommended_action: Before ordering from Zales, ask in writing whether a ring sized to order can still be returned after independent testing, and capture full contact details from the order confirmation.

flags.title: Credit-card acceptance verified for Zales only; not verified for Blue Nile, VRAI or Brilliant Earth
flags.detail: The checklist prefers a credit card for purchase protection. UPDATED 2026-10-22 (session S-75094819): Zales' standalone return policy names 'Credit and Debit Cards' as an original-purchase tender ('The same account will be credited'), so card acceptance is verified for Zales (networks not named). For Blue Nile, VRAI and Brilliant Earth, no retrieved page states accepted card networks. Affirm / Wells Fargo financing and PayPal are mentioned on some pages, which are not equivalent to a card purchase. Those fields are left blank rather than assumed.
flags.recommended_action: Confirm card acceptance at checkout and keep the card-issuer dispute window in mind.

flags.title: LBMA fix prices are behind an IBA licence; a different official quote was used
flags.detail: lbma.org.uk states that tabulated LBMA Precious Metal Prices have moved to the MyLBMA portal and require an IBA licence. No free LBMA fix value could be retrieved. The calculator therefore uses the World Gold Council gold spot page (market data by ICE Data Services) with an explicit quote date.
flags.recommended_action: For contract-grade valuations, obtain LBMA data under licence or use your jeweller's own assay price.

flags.title: Costco items were excluded because price and gram weight did not render
flags.detail: Two Costco 14kt diamond ring pages were retrieved. The product page returned full specifications, shipping and returns text but no price and no gram weight (both are client-side). A cached snippet showed a $3,999.99 price for a different solitaire, which cannot be tied to a retrieved page. Costco is therefore listed as a candidate retailer but contributes no rows.
flags.recommended_action: If Costco is wanted, capture the price while signed in and ask the jewellery desk for the gram weight.

flags.title: Setting-only prices and complete-ring prices sit in the same tables
flags.detail: 8 Blue Nile rows, the Brilliant Earth row and the VRAI row are 'Setting Price' / 'Setting Only' - the center diamond is extra. The 4 Zales rows and the 3 Stone and Strand rows are complete rings including diamonds. A $1,000 setting and a $900 complete ring are not comparable, and price-per-gram cannot be computed where the diamond dominates. Every row carries a price_basis label so the two groups can be separated.
flags.recommended_action: Compare setting prices with setting prices only; add a centre-stone quote before comparing with a complete ring.

flags.title: All 3 Stone and Strand rings are final sale / non-returnable — they cannot be returned after independent testing
flags.detail: Each of the three Stone and Strand product pages retrieved on 2026-10-22 shows 'Final Sale — This product is non-returnable' (for Rita and Mia it is also in the Product Description bullets verbatim), on the same page that advertises '100 Day Returns'. The retailer's returns policy confirms the exclusion: 'Any piece marked as final sale on the product page or purchased at a discount of 50% or greater' cannot be returned or exchanged. Rita (60% off) and Mia (50% off) are non-returnable on the discount rule alone. Consequence for this project's method: the receive → independent XRF test → return if it fails sequence cannot be followed for these three rings at these prices. They are published here because they are the first captured listings to say 'solid gold' — not as recommendations.
flags.recommended_action: Do not buy these three rings as listed if post-delivery verification matters — there is no return path. If buying from Stone and Strand, choose an item that is not marked final sale and is discounted less than 50%, and get written confirmation before paying that it can be returned after independent testing.

flags.title: The Mia Ring page contradicts itself on karat: spec table says 14K, image alt text says 10K
flags.detail: On the live Mia Ring page retrieved 2026-10-22, the structured Metals spec states 'Gold Karat: 14K', while the product-image alt text on the same page repeatedly says '10K Yellow Gold The Mia Diamond Ring'. The published karat (14) is taken from the spec table, the structured source; the conflicting alt text is quoted in evidence/listings/solid-gold.md and the item's verification status is downgraded to reflect the conflict. One of the two numbers on the retailer's own page is wrong; this dataset cannot determine which.
flags.recommended_action: Ask Stone and Strand in writing which karat the Mia Ring actually is, and keep the reply. An XRF test after delivery would settle it — but note this ring is final sale (F-016), so there is no return if the test disagrees with the listing.

flags.title: Catbird not yet included: product-detail text was absent from the retrieved pages, so nothing could be evidence-quoted
flags.detail: On 2026-10-22 (session S-75094819) two Catbird engagement product pages were fetched in full (Night at the Ballet Diamond Ring, Emerald Cut — 'from $5,300.00' visible; Odile the Swan Black Diamond Ring — 'from $1,600.00' visible). In both cases the retrieved text contained the product name and starting price but NOT the materials/details block, so karat, solid-gold wording, width and weight could not be backed by verbatim quotes and no rows were added. Search snippets for these pages show material details, but snippets are rejected sources in this project (F-004/F-005/F-006). Catbird is a promising candidate for a future pass with a fetcher that can read the details tab.
flags.recommended_action: Re-attempt Catbird capture with a browser that renders the product-details section; only add rows once karat and any 'solid gold' wording can be quoted verbatim from the page itself.
